capabilities: Translate, expand, summarize and proofread selected text
Run custom actions with user-defined emoji, title and system prompt
Chat with the model about the selection and apply the result
Stream results into the note with undo and cancel
Review an old-to-new diff before replacing text
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. UI and default prompts are in English and German. The API key is stored in the vault's plugin data.json and sent only to the configured endpoint; no data is collected.
motivation: To bring the author's browser-extension actions, prompts and streaming behaviour into the Obsidian editor.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send note text to an LLM for translation, rewriting or summarizing without leaving the editor.

relations.evidence: the Obsidian edition of LLM Text Assistant — the browser extension (Chrome/Firefox/Thunderbird) by the same author

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint (cloud or local)
API key for the configured endpoint

summary: Sends selected text or the whole note to any OpenAI-compatible LLM for translation, expansion, summaries, grammar fixes and custom prompts.
